1.2 Objectives of the Deployment Project:
1. To develop and implement within the MdM Consortium the Deployment of EU Aid
Volunteers, which follows the EU regulations and MdM’s vision in the 27 months duration of
the project.
2. To implement within the MdM Consortium International Volunteering and Security policies,
HR procedures and Training tools, which follow the EU regulations and MdM’s vision and with
a Gender perspective.
3. To support and complement Humanitarian Aid in MdM Third countries offices, with a focus
on strengthening the capacity and resilience of vulnerable and disaster affected communities.
4. To ensure overall consistency of the MdM Consortium for Deployment project, between
needs assessment, gaps identified and the implementation of the agreed activities, according
to the Work plan.
5. To raise awareness about UE Volunteers Initiative and Humanitarian Aid towards European
civil society and the Third countries.

2. Evaluation purpose
The current evaluation is meant to be performed right before completion of the Deployment
Project (Number; 592486) - EU Aid Volunteers. The main objective of this evaluation is to
assess to what extent the Deployment-EU Aid Volunteers has contributed to achieve the
expected results. The evaluation should also analyse the project implementation and the
feasible sustainability. It is mainly concerned with assessing achieved impacts, identifying and
judging unexpected impacts and verifying the sustainability of the project's benefits in the
framework of the MdM Consortium.
The final product will be the conduct of the evaluation.
For the evaluation the purpose is twofold, focusing not only on the Project, but also on the
Partnership performance throughout the implementation of the specific Project activities.
The main users of these evaluations includes MdM Spain staff, such as project managers,
operators in charge of the project conception, implementation, but also three MdM partners
from the MdM Deployment project to whom accountability is required in the framework of
the Project.
The MdM Consortium team hopes that these evaluations may help to make improved
decisions, to further articulate judgments on the development of future similar Deployment-
related activities, as well as to better understand the effects of the Projects.

3. Specific objectives
4. As MdM participates as a Consortium in the EU Aid Volunteers Initiative, and MdM-
Spain as Head of Consortium, it is relevant for us to evaluate: The EU Aid Volunteers
Initiative Deployment project implementation according to the Project Logical
framework, Work Plan and Budget and aligned with the EU regulations and EU-MdM
Grant Agreement.

5. Evaluate the MdM Deployment project Consortium management process throughout
the implementation of the Project, the external Consultancies and aligned with the
organization's volunteering policies.
